subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds words using phonics sounds taught during the year

show.line: You know so many sounds now! Let's build words with all of them. f-l-a-g. Flag! Shark, train, coin, bird.

rounds.prompt: Listen. c-r-a-b. Push the sounds together. What word is it?
Which tiles build the word shark?
Listen. s-p-o-t. What word is it?
Which tiles build the word train?

rounds.praise: Yes! Coin, with the oy sound.

accept: the shark swims in the sea
a shark swims in the sea
the shark swims in the see

hints: Say each sound, then push them together.
Look for two letters that make one sound, like in shark and train.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will build the word frog.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I left out r. My tiles say fog.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's build it together. f-r-o-g. Frog!

parent_line: Can build and read words using all the sounds learnt this year.
